'''Gabbera''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Klatooinian/Legends|Klatooinian]] who worked for [[Zonnos Anjiliac Priare|Zonnos the Hutt]] as a translator, during the rule of the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]]. Gabbera had been born into slavery, and was turned over to Zonnos as payment for a gambling debt. A cowardly individual, he was an excellent [[Pilot/Legends|pilot]], and had passed his skills onto many within Zonnos' operations. When [[Popara Anjiliac Diresto|Popara]] hired a group of freelance agents to rescue his other offspring, [[Mika Anjiliac Chiera]], Zonnos allowed Gabbera to accompany Popara's agents as a pilot and guide.
